This repository contains the code needed to replicate the experiments described in the research article of the same title: Continuous and Ordinal Machine Learning for Kansei-Based Product Perception: Predictive Equivalence and Explainable Modeling

# Library

```{r}
packages <- c("tidyverse","ordinal","ranger","gbm","xgboost","e1071","FNN","kernelshap")
suppressMessages(invisible(lapply(packages,library, character.only = TRUE)))
sessionInfo()
```

# Configuration

```{r}
name_case <- "controller"
cfgs <- switch (name_case,
                controller = list(name_dat = "VideoController.txt",
                                  target = "Ergonomic",
                                  out = paste0("result_",name_case)),
                harness = list(name_dat = "Harness.txt",
                               target = "Strength",
                               out = paste0("result_",name_case))
)

folds_inner <- 4
n_boot <- 2000
n_perm <- 10
n_cores <- 4
eq_margins <- c(0.05,0.10,0.25)
SEED <- 2026

dir.create(cfgs$out, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(SEED)

pairs_models <- data.frame(
  cont = c("LM_PCA","KNN_mean","RF","GB","XGB","SVR"),
  ord = c("CO_PCA","KNN_median","RF_Ord","GB_Ord","XGB_Ord","SVR_Ord")
)
models <- as.vector(t(pairs_models))
```

# Data

```{r}
dat <- read.table(cfgs$name_dat, header = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(Design = factor(Design))
X <- dat |> select(-all_of(c("ParticipantID","Fold",cfgs$target)))
Y <- dat |> pull(cfgs$target)
```

# Supervised Models

## Auxiliar Functions

```{r}
clip <- function(x) pmin(pmax(floor(x + 0.5), 1),5)
pl <- function(x,FUN){
  if(n_cores > 1 && .Platform$OS.type != "windows")
    parallel::mclapply(x,FUN,mc.cores = n_cores, mc.preschedule = FALSE) 
  else
      lapply(x,FUN)
}

metrics <- function(obs,pred_ord,pred_cont){
  #QWK
  w <- outer(1:5,1:5,function(i,j) (i-j)^2/16)
  o <- table(factor(obs,1:5),factor(pred_ord,1:5))
  e <- outer(rowSums(o), colSums(o))/sum(o)
  
  c(RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs-pred_cont)^2)),
    MAE = mean(abs(obs-pred_cont)),
    Acc_pm1 = mean(abs(obs-pred_ord) <= 1),
    QWK = 1-sum(w*o)/sum(w*e),
    Spearman = cor(obs,pred_ord,method = "spearman"))
}
```

## Grid hyperparameters

```{r}
grids <- list(
  LM_PCA = expand.grid(n_pc = 2:6),
  CO_PCA = expand.grid(n_pc = 2:6),
  KNN_mean = expand.grid(n_pc = 2:6, k = c(3,5,7,9,11)), 
  KNN_median = expand.grid(n_pc = 2:6, k = c(3,5,7,9,11)),
  RF = expand.grid(mtry = c(3,5,7), min.node = c(3,5,10)), 
  RF_Ord = expand.grid(mtry = c(3,5,7), min.node = c(3,5,10)),
  GB = expand.grid(n_trees = c(50,100,200), depth = 1:3, eta = c(0.05,0.1)),
  GB_Ord = expand.grid(n_trees = c(50,100,200), depth = 1:3, eta = c(0.05,0.1)),
  XGB = expand.grid(n_trees = c(50,100,200), depth = 1:3, eta = c(0.05,0.1)),
  XGB_Ord = expand.grid(n_trees = c(50,100,200), depth = 1:3, eta = c(0.05,0.1)),
  SVR = expand.grid(cost = 2^seq(-1,2), gamma = c(0.01,0.05,0.1)),
  SVR_Ord = expand.grid(cost = 2^seq(-1,2), gamma = c(0.01,0.05,0.1))
)
```

## Frank and Hall decomposition

```{r}
FrankHall_decomp <- function(X,Y,L,hp){
  mods <- lapply(1:4, function(k){
    z <- as.numeric(Y > k)
    L$fit(X,z,hp)
  })
  function(X){
    p <- vapply(mods,function(m) as.numeric(L$pred(m,X,hp)), numeric(nrow(X)))
    p <- t(apply(p,1,cummin))
    Prob <- cbind(1 - p[,1], p[,1] - p[,2], p[,2] - p[,3], p[,3] - p[,4], p[,4])
    Prob[Prob < 0 & Prob > -1e-10] <- 0
    Prob / rowSums(Prob)
  }
}

FH_Ordinals <- list(
  GB = list(
    fit = function(X,z,hp) gbm(z ~ ., data = data.frame(X, z = z), 
                               distribution = "bernoulli", n.trees = hp$n_trees,
                               interaction.depth = hp$depth, shrinkage = hp$eta,
                               n.minobsinnode = 3, verbose = FALSE),
    pred = function(m,X,hp) predict(m,X,n.trees = hp$n_trees, type = "response")
  ),
  XGB = list(
    fit = function(X,z,hp) xgb.train(params = list(objective = "binary:logistic",
                                                   max_depth = hp$depth, eta = hp$eta,
                                                   nthread = 1),
                                     data = xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(X), label = z),
                                     nrounds = hp$n_trees, verbose = 0),
    pred = function(m,X,hp) predict(m,as.matrix(X))
  ),
  SVR = list(
    fit = function(X,z,hp) svm(X,factor(z), kernel = "radial",
                               cost = hp$cost, gamma = hp$gamma, 
                               probability = TRUE),
    pred = function(m,X,hp) attr(predict(m,X,probability = TRUE),"probabilities")[,"1"]
  )
)
```

## Fit models

```{r}
fit_model <- function(m,X_train,Y_train,hp){
  
  set.seed(SEED)
  num_cols <- setdiff(names(X_train),"Design")
  mu <- colMeans(X_train[,num_cols]); sigma <- apply(X_train[,num_cols],2,sd); sigma[sigma == 0] <- 1
  Z <- function(X) as.data.frame(scale(X[,num_cols,drop = FALSE],mu,sigma))
  Dummies <- function(X){
    D <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(~ Design, X)[,-1,drop = FALSE])
    names(D) <- make.names(names(D)); D
  }
  Fz <- function(X) cbind(Z(X),Dummies(X))
  Fr <- function(X) cbind(Z(X),Dummies(X))
  
  pca <- prcomp(Z(X_train))
  Fp <- function(X) cbind(as.data.frame(predict(pca,Z(X))[,1:hp$n_pc,drop = FALSE]), Dummies(X))
  
  Y_factor <- droplevels(factor(Y_train, levels = 1:5, ordered = TRUE))
  
  cont <- function(ev) list(ev = ev, pred = function(X) clip(ev(X)))
  ord <- function(prob) list(prob = prob,
                             ev = function(X) as.vector(prob(X) %*% 1:5),
                             pred = function(X) apply(prob(X),1,function(r) which(cumsum(r) >= 0.5 - 1e-9)[1]))
  vec <- function(){
    F_train <- Fp(X_train)
    muk <- colMeans(F_train); sigmak <- apply(F_train,2,sd); sigmak[sigmak == 0] <- 1
    K_train <- scale(F_train,muk,sigmak)
    function(X) get.knnx(K_train,scale(Fp(X),muk,sigmak),
                         k = hp$k)$nn.index
  }
  
  mt <- function() min(hp$mtry, ncol(Fr(X_train)))
  
  switch (m,
    LM_PCA = {fit <- lm(y ~ ., data.frame(y = Y_train, Fp(X_train)))
              cont(function(X) as.numeric(predict(fit,Fp(X))))},
    CO_PCA = {Ftr <- Fp(X_train)
              fit <- clm(reformulate(names(Ftr),"y"),
                         data = data.frame(y = Y_factor, Ftr))
              ord(function(X) predict(fit, newdata = Fp(X), type = "prob")$fit)},
    KNN_mean = {nn <- vec()
                cont(function(X) apply(nn(X), 1, function(i) mean(Y_train[i])))},
    KNN_median = {nn <- vec()
                  ord(function(X) t(apply(nn(X),1,function(i) tabulate(as.integer(Y_train[i]),5)/ hp$k)))},
    RF = {fit <- ranger(y ~ ., data.frame(y = Y_train, Fr(X_train)),
                         num.trees = 500, mtry = mt(), 
                         min.node.size = hp$min.node, num.threads = 1)
          cont(function(X) predict(fit, Fr(X))$predictions)},
    RF_Ord = {rp <- ranger(y ~ ., data.frame(y = factor(Y_train, ordered = FALSE), Fr(X_train)),
                           probability = TRUE, num.trees = 500, mtry = mt(), 
                           min.node.size = hp$min.node, num.threads = 1)
                           ord(function(X) predict(rp,Fr(X))$predictions)},
    GB = {fit <- gbm(y ~ ., data.frame(y = Y_train, Fr(X_train)),
                     distribution = "gaussian", n.trees = hp$n_trees,
                     interaction.depth = hp$depth, shrinkage = hp$eta,
                     n.minobsinnode = 3, verbose = FALSE)
          cont(function(X) predict(fit, Fr(X), n.trees = hp$n_trees))},
    GB_Ord = {fh <- FrankHall_decomp(Fr(X_train), Y_train, 
                                      FH_Ordinals$GB, hp)
               ord(function(X) fh(Fr(X)))},
    XGB = {fit <- xgb.train(params = list(objective = "reg:squarederror",
                                           max_depth = hp$depth, eta = hp$eta, nthread = 1),
                             data = xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(Fr(X_train)), label = Y_train),
                             nrounds = hp$n_trees, verbose = 0)
            cont(function(X) predict(fit, as.matrix(Fr(X))))},
    XGB_Ord = {fh <- FrankHall_decomp(Fr(X_train), Y_train, 
                                       FH_Ordinals$XGB, hp)
                ord(function(X) fh(Fr(X)))},
    SVR = {fit <- svm(y ~ ., data.frame(y = Y_train, Fz(X_train)), type = "eps-regression",
                       kernel = "radial",cost = hp$cost, gamma = hp$gamma)
            cont(function(X) as.numeric(predict(fit,Fz(X))))},
    SVR_Ord = {fh <- FrankHall_decomp(Fr(X_train), Y_train, 
                                       FH_Ordinals$SVR, hp)
                ord(function(X) fh(Fr(X)))}
  )
}
```

## Nested Cross-Validation

```{r}
tune <- function(m, X_train, Y_train, sub_train, seed = SEED){
  
  set.seed(seed)
  grid <- grids[[m]]
  us <- unique(sub_train)
  inner <- setNames(sample(rep(1:folds_inner, length.out = length(us))), us)[as.character(sub_train)]
  cv_MAE <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(j){
    
    hp <- as.list(grid[j, , drop = FALSE])
    p <- rep(NA_real_, length(Y_train))
    for(k in 1:folds_inner){
      ii_train <- inner != k; ii_val <- inner == k
      fit <- fit_model(m, X_train[ii_train, , drop = FALSE], Y_train[ii_train], hp)
      p[ii_val] <- fit$ev(X_train[ii_val, , drop = FALSE])
    }
    mean(abs(Y_train - p))
  })
  j <- which.min(cv_MAE)
  table <- cbind(config_id = seq_len(nrow(grid)), grid, cv_MAE = cv_MAE)
  list(hp = as.list(grid[j, , drop = FALSE]), cv_MAE = cv_MAE[j], 
       table = table)
}
```

## Algorithms execution

```{r}
oof <- data.frame(subject = dat$ParticipantID, design = dat$Design, obs = Y)
for(m in models) oof[[m]] <- NA_real_
oof_ev <- oof #continuous predictions
best_hp <- list()

for(f in sort(unique(dat$Fold))){
  
  cat("Extern Fold", f, "\n")
  tr <- dat$Fold != f
  res <- pl(models, function(m){
    
    tn <- tune(m, X[tr, ], Y[tr], dat$ParticipantID[tr])
    fit <- fit_model(m, X[tr, ], Y[tr], tn$hp)
    list(pred = fit$pred(X[!tr,]), ev = fit$ev(X[!tr,]),
         hp = tn$hp, cv = tn$cv_MAE,
         tunning = transform(tn$table, model = m, extern_fold = f))
  })
  
  for(i in seq_along(models)){
    
    oof[[models[i]]][!tr] <- res[[i]]$pred
    oof_ev[[models[[i]]]][!tr] <- res[[i]]$ev
    best_hp[[paste(models[i],f)]] <- res[[i]]$hp
    
  }

}

```

# Inference Results

## Metrics and CI 95% Bootstrap

```{r}
set.seed(SEED)
est <- sapply(models, function(m) metrics(oof$obs, oof[[m]], oof_ev[[m]]))
idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(oof)), oof$subject)
```

```{r}
bs <- replicate(n_boot,{
  i <- unlist(idx[sample(names(idx), replace = TRUE)])
  sapply(models, function(m) metrics(oof$obs[i], oof[[m]][i], oof_ev[[m]][i]))
})
lo <- apply(bs, c(1,2), quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
hi <- apply(bs, c(1,2), quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

CI_table <- matrix(sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", est, lo, hi), nrow(est), dimnames = dimnames(est))
print(CI_table)
```

## TOST equivalence

```{r}
TOST <- function(d, delta, B = n_boot){
  
  set.seed(SEED)
  d <- d[is.finite(d)]
  bd <- replicate(B, mean(sample(d, length(d), replace = TRUE)))
  ci_boot <- quantile(bd, c(0.05,0.95), names = FALSE)
  
  lo_p <- t.test(d, mu = -delta, alternative = "greater")$p.value
  hi_p <- t.test(d, mu = delta, alternative = "less")$p.value
  
  c(dif_MAE = mean(d), 
    lo_CI = ci_boot[1], hi_CI = ci_boot[2], p = max(lo_p,hi_p))
}

pairs_modelsTOST <- pairs_models[c(1,3:6),]
MAE <- sapply(models, function(m) tapply(abs(oof_ev$obs - oof_ev[[m]]), oof_ev$subject, mean))
dif <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs_modelsTOST)), 
                           function(i) MAE[, pairs_modelsTOST$cont[i]] - MAE[, pairs_modelsTOST$ord[i]])

res <- list()
for(delta in eq_margins){
  
  tt <- t(sapply(dif, TOST, delta = delta))
  res[[as.character(delta)]] <- data.frame(margin = delta, pair = paste0(pairs_modelsTOST$cont, " vs ", pairs_modelsTOST$ord),
                                           TOST = round(tt,4), pHolm = p.adjust(tt[,"p"], method = "holm"))
}

print(res)
```

# Kansei Adjectives Importance

```{r}
imp_models <- c("LM_PCA","RF","GB","XGB","SVR")
kansei <- setdiff(colnames(X), "Design")
normalize <- function(x){
  x <- pmax(x,0)
  100*x/sum(x)
}
```

## Permutation importance

```{r}
perm_imp <- function(model,nper = n_perm){
  set.seed(SEED)
  folds <- sort(unique(dat$Fold))
  imp_f <- array(0, c(length(kansei),length(model),length(folds)), dimnames = list(kansei,model,paste0("Fold",folds)))
  for(f in folds){
    
    tr <- dat$Fold != f; Xte <- X[!tr, ,drop = FALSE]; Yte <- Y[!tr]
    for(m in model){
      fit <- fit_model(m, X[tr, ,drop = FALSE], Y[tr],best_hp[[paste(m,f)]])
      rmse_b <- sqrt(mean((Yte - fit$ev(Xte))^2))
      for(v in kansei){
        imp_f[v,m,f] <- mean(replicate(nper,{Xp <- Xte; Xp[[v]] <- sample(Xp[[v]]);
                                             sqrt(mean((Yte - fit$ev(Xp))^2)) - rmse_b}))
      }
    }
  }
  imp_f
  
}

imp <- apply(perm_imp(imp_models),c(1,2),mean)
rel_imp <- apply(imp,2,normalize)
print(rel_imp)
```

## SHAP

```{r}
final_model <- setNames(pl(imp_models, function(m){tn <- tune(m,X,Y,dat$ParticipantID)
                                                   fit_model(m,X,Y,tn$hp)}), imp_models)
shap <- lapply(final_model, function(ft){
  set.seed(SEED)
  r <- kernelshap(ft, X = X, bg_X = X, verbose = FALSE, 
                  parallel = FALSE, pred_fun = function(object, newdata, ...) object$ev(newdata))
  r$S})

shap_imp <- sapply(shap, function(s) colMeans(abs(as.matrix(s)))[kansei]) 
rel_shap <- apply(shap_imp,2,normalize)
print(rel_shap)
```
